svg.title: Boltz-2 regulator benchmark: does a co-folding model rank an enzyme's known allosteric regulator above decoy metabolites?
svg.desc: Four-column schematic: 12 known enzyme-regulator pairs with six decoys each, co-folding with Boltz-2 to obtain structure confidence, binder probability and affinity, ranking the regulator among seven ligands against a uniform-rank null, and three pre-specified readouts plus the training-data caveat.

g.text: 1 diffusion sample each, run on CPU
MSA computed once per enzyme, then reused
score = share of decoys the regulator beats
If only sugars are beaten, it
Most of these complexes have pre-2023
PDB structures, so Boltz-2 has probably
seen them: this tests recall of known
